title: .coderabbit.yaml
body:
# CodeRabbit — AI code review configuration.
#
# ⚠️ COST ASSESSMENT (reconciled with P15-01 inventory, 2026-08-17):
#   Free tier covers PR summarization + release notes across unlimited public
#   and private repositories, but actual PR code reviews are $24/dev/month (Pro).
#   For a zero-cost project, only the basic summary/chat free tier is available.
#
# This config is INERT until the owner installs the CodeRabbit GitHub App AND
# upgrades to a paid tier. The free tier's limitations are documented above.
# No repository secret is required (GitHub App auth only). Verified: P15-01
# found CodeRabbit "INERT" — no in-repo config, no secret present.
#
# Tuned DOWN per sprint doctrine: ~290 commits on the eventual PR would produce
# an unreadable flood. Profile is "quiet" (only the most important feedback).
#
# Scope: pull_request only (CodeRabbit's GitHub App default — it does not run
# on push or schedule without explicit config).
#
# Schema verified against: https://docs.coderabbit.ai/reference/configuration
# (last updated: August 11, 2026)
language: "en-US"

reviews:
  profile: "quiet"
  request_changes_workflow: false
  high_level_summary: true
  poem: false
  review_status: true
  review_details: false
  auto_review:
    enabled: true
    drafts: false

chat:
  auto_reply: true

title: .env.example
body:
# Database
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/sports_platform"
DIRECT_URL="postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/sports_platform"

# Cost control: how much of each provider payload to store in Postgres. The SHA-256
# hash + byte count are kept ALWAYS (the audit chain); this only governs the raw JSON.
#   hash-only → store only a small stub (DEFAULT IN PRODUCTION — protects Neon storage)
#   db-full   → store the full raw payload (default in dev for debugging)
SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_MODE=""
# Retention window (days) for scripts/db/prune-usage.mjs (reclaims old raw payloads).
SNAPSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS="7"

# Auth
NEXTAUTH_SECRET="your-secret-here-generate-with-openssl-rand-base64-32"
# Comma-separated owner/operator emails elevated to ADMIN at session time
# (the founder path into /cockpit — no manual DB write needed)
ADMIN_EMAILS=""
# OPERATOR (production): set to the EXACT live canonical host, WITH the `www`:
#   NEXTAUTH_URL=https://www.galaxysportsedge.com
# This MUST match NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL (below) and the canonical host the code
# defaults to. A mismatched host (e.g. the apex galaxysportsedge.com) sends OAuth
# callbacks / post-checkout redirects to a non-primary host.
NEXTAUTH_URL="http://localhost:3000"

# OAuth Providers
# OPERATOR (production): in the Google Cloud Console OAuth client, the Authorized
# redirect URIs MUST include the www callback:
#   https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/api/auth/callback/google
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=""
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=""

# Local-dev admin (seed-only)
# Setting this and running `npm run db:seed` upserts a User row with this
# email and role=ADMIN. Sign in via Google with the matching account to
# land in /cockpit as admin. Seed refuses to run when NODE_ENV=production
# even if this var is set, so it cannot promote anyone in prod.
DEV_ADMIN_EMAIL=""
DEV_ADMIN_NAME="Local Admin"

# Dev-mode shortcut: when "true" the auth() helper returns a synthetic
# admin session so /admin and /cockpit render without real Google OAuth.
# Middleware also short-circuits its cookie check on this flag. The
# bypass is ignored when NODE_ENV=production.
DEV_FAKE_ADMIN="false"

# Demo picks: when "true" (and DATABASE_URL is unset / stub mode is
# active), /picks and /dashboard render deterministic sample picks so a
# reviewer can see the surface without configuring real ingestion.
# Result is always PENDING — no fake win-rate ever leaks.
DEMO_PICKS_ENABLED="false"

# Public fantasy tools: keep false until live projections/ADP/salary inputs
# are wired. When false, illustrative fantasy tool URLs redirect to /fantasy
# and the only public live path is read-only roster sync.
FANTASY_PUBLIC_TOOLS_ENABLED="false"

# Projections data provider. Leave UNSET for the honest default: projections are
# labelled "illustrative" until a real provider is wired. Setting this opts into a
# live projections source (the first cold visitor may briefly still see illustrative).
# Does NOT flip canPublishProjections — that remains a separate, proof-gated decision.
PROJECTIONS_PROVIDER=""

# FABLE / AWS evidence lane: all live AWS and public-demo actions default off.
GSE_FABLE_LIVE_PUBLIC_DEMO_ENABLED="false"
FABLE_AWS_ALLOW_EXPERIMENTS="false"
FABLE_AWS_ALLOW_DEPLOY="false"
FABLE_AWS_ALLOW_PAID_RESOURCES="false"
FABLE_AWS_MAX_MONTHLY_COST_USD="0"

# Airwave media intelligence: all lanes default off. These flags only expose
# readiness and dry-run plans until a worker is explicitly built and scheduled.
AIRWAVE_ENABLED="false"
AIRWAVE_SIRIUSXM_LEGAL_ACK="false"
AIRWAVE_TRANSCRIPT_IMPORT_ENABLED="false"
AIRWAVE_TRANSCRIPT_SHEET_ID=""
AIRWAVE_TRANSCRIPT_WORKSHEET_NAME=""
AIRWAVE_TRANSCRIPT_FILE_PATH=""
AIRWAVE_YOUTUBE_FEEDS_ENABLED="false"
AIRWAVE_PODCAST_RSS_ENABLED="false"
AIRWAVE_BEAT_REPORTS_ENABLED="false"
AIRWAVE_STUDIO_HANDOFF_ENABLED="false"

# Visual production (Higgsfield) — generation is BLOCKED unless BOTH are true.
# Even then, each asset must pass its Film Room checklist + per-asset owner approval.
HIGGSFIELD_GENERATION_ENABLED="false"
OWNER_VISUAL_SPEND_APPROVED="false"

# Stripe
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY="sk_test_..."
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET="whsec_..."
# Per-tier, per-interval price IDs (create in Stripe TEST mode; amounts shown to
# users come from the current pricing phase in apps/web/lib/pricing/pricing-phases.ts).
STRIPE_PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE_ID="price_..."
STRIPE_PRO_ANNUAL_PRICE_ID="price_..."
STRIPE_ELITE_MONTHLY_PRICE_ID="price_..."
STRIPE_ELITE_ANNUAL_PRICE_ID="price_..."
# Fantasy tier ($49/yr Founding) — the cheaper fantasy-only tier below Pro. Create
# these prices in Stripe (test, then live) before the Fantasy checkout can complete.
STRIPE_FANTASY_MONTHLY_PRICE_ID="price_..."
STRIPE_FANTASY_ANNUAL_PRICE_ID="price_..."
NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY="pk_test_..."

# Point-of-sale Terms-of-Service consent at Stripe Checkout (FTC ROSCA + state
# auto-renewal laws). DEFAULT OFF. When "true", the Checkout Session is created
# with consent_collection.terms_of_service = "required", so buyers must accept the
# linked Terms before the first recurring charge.
#
# ORDER MATTERS — do NOT flip this on blind: Stripe REJECTS the Checkout Session
# (every new subscription checkout 500s) if the account has no public
# Terms-of-Service URL set. So:
#   1. FIRST set the Terms-of-Service URL in the Stripe Dashboard
#      (Settings → Public business information / Checkout & Payment Links).
#   2. THEN set STRIPE_TERMS_CONSENT_ENABLED="true" and redeploy.
# Left unset/"false", checkout omits consent_collection and behaves exactly as
# before (safe). The recurring-billing line near the submit button and the
# on-page auto-renew disclosure are always shown regardless of this flag.
STRIPE_TERMS_CONSENT_ENABLED="false"

# Pricing phase — the named price ladder rung that is live. Defaults to FOUNDING
# (lowest, bootstrap). Advance only when the named proof milestone is met AND the
# added value has shipped: FOUNDING -> PROVEN -> ESTABLISHED -> AUTHORITY.
PRICING_PHASE="FOUNDING"

# The Odds API (https://the-odds-api.com) — PRIMARY odds/lines aggregator.
THE_ODDS_API_KEY=""

# Forward line archive (the Glass Ledger) — timestamped OPEN/INTERIM/CLOSE
# OddsLineSnapshot rows (packages/ingestion-pipeline/src/line-archive.ts).
# DEFAULT OFF. Persists odds the refresh cycle already fetches; makes no new
# Odds API calls of its own.
LINE_ARCHIVE_ENABLED="false"
# Pinnacle closing-line leg of the archive (the program's PRIMARY CLV
# benchmark), served only under The Odds API's `eu` region
# (packages/ingestion-pipeline/src/pinnacle-line-archive.ts). DOUBLE-GATED —
# requires LINE_ARCHIVE_ENABLED="true" AND this flag "true"; either off (the
# default) makes zero extra API calls. When both are on, adds AT MOST ONE
# extra Odds API request per sport per refresh (regions=eu,
# bookmakers=pinnacle) — mind the free-tier 500 credits/month budget noted in
# data-ingestion/src/config.ts before flipping this on.
LINE_ARCHIVE_EU_PINNACLE="false"

# Watchlist alerts (apps/web/lib/watchlist/alert-dispatch.ts) — the
# GRADED-only follow-alert loop (never an ungraded tip). DEFAULT OFF. Even
# when "true", every alert still requires the recipient to be ELITE
# (real-time email & push alerts, per the tier table) AND the underlying
# pick to be settled. Both real channels below independently no-op when
# their own env vars are unset, so this flag alone does not guarantee
# delivery — see each channel module's doc comment for the typed seam.
WATCHLIST_ALERTS_ENABLED="false"

# Web Push channel (apps/web/lib/watchlist/channels/web-push-channel.ts) —
# free, no-vendor-account transport for watchlist alerts (VAPID / RFC 8291).
# Generate a real pair with `npx web-push generate-vapid-keys` (or
# `web-push`'s generateVAPIDKeys()) — never fabricate placeholder keys.
# All three must be set for push to actually send; any one missing makes
# sendWebPushAlert() honestly no-op with detail "not_configured".
# The PUBLIC key only (never the private key) is also read client-side to
# call PushManager.subscribe() — see apps/web/lib/push/use-push-subscription.ts.
NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=""
VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=""
# Contact address the push service may use to reach the sender — a
# mailto: URI, e.g. "mailto:ops@galaxysportsedge.com".
VAPID_SUBJECT=""

# Email channel (apps/web/lib/watchlist/channels/email-channel.ts) —
# transactional email via Resend (https://resend.com) for watchlist alerts.
# Both must be set for email to actually send; either missing makes
# sendAlertEmail() honestly no-op with detail "not_configured". Alerts are
# sent ONLY to a NextAuth-verified email address — never an unconfirmed one.
RESEND_API_KEY=""
# Verified Resend sending address/domain, e.g. "alerts@galaxysportsedge.com".
ALERTS_EMAIL_FROM=""

# Anthropic Claude API (https://console.anthropic.com) — content + glass-box
# explainer + loss-autopsy drafts. Without it those surfaces return 503; the
# deterministic engine is unaffected.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-ant-..."

# ── Staged data sources (decided 2026-06-03; not yet wired into ingestion) ──
# odds-api.io (https://odds-api.io) — SECONDARY book aggregator for failover
# (#5). Leave empty until the failover adapter is wired; the merge logic exists.
ODDS_API_IO_KEY=""
# API-Sports (https://api-sports.io) — results/settlement/stats provider.
API_SPORTS_KEY=""
# Kalshi exchange (CLV / fair value) needs NO key — public read-only endpoints.

# Master switch for the Poisson independent estimator (#11). Set to "true" ONLY
# after a real team-rate ingestion path is live; guards against scoring on
# synthesized rates. Default false.
TEAM_RATES_AVAILABLE="false"

# Bearer secret the Vercel cron endpoints check (e.g. /api/cron/settle-picks).
# Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
CRON_SECRET=""

# --- Community moderation: anonymous reports (directive 4.1) -----------------
# Feature gate for POST /api/moderation/anonymous-report. Default OFF; the
# route returns 404 unless this is exactly "true".
ANONYMOUS_MODERATION_REPORTS_ENABLED="false"
# Server-side HMAC secret for deriving anonymous-report rate-limit
# fingerprints from the platform-observed client IP. The raw IP is never
# persisted or logged — only the HMAC digest is used as a rate key.
# REQUIRED (>= 16 chars) for the route to operate; missing/short => 503.
# Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
MODERATION_REPORT_HMAC_SECRET=""
# SELF-HOSTING ONLY (leave empty on Vercel, where the platform overwrites
# x-real-ip / x-forwarded-for): name of the ONE header your own reverse proxy
# sets with the real client IP (e.g. "x-real-ip" when nginx overwrites it, or
# "x-forwarded-for" — the LAST hop is used, per append semantics). When unset
# off-Vercel, NO forwarding header is trusted (they are client-spoofable) and
# anonymous reports fail closed with 400.
MODERATION_REPORT_TRUSTED_IP_HEADER=""

# Redis (BullMQ)
REDIS_URL="redis://localhost:6379"

# App
NODE_ENV="development"
# Canonical public base URL. Everything absolute (metadataBase, sitemap, robots,
# canonical tags, JSON-LD, RSS, bot links) resolves off this via lib/seo/site-url.ts.
# OPERATOR (production): set to the EXACT live host, WITH the `www`:
#   NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://www.galaxysportsedge.com
# When unset, the code defaults to https://www.galaxysportsedge.com (never the apex).
# Keep this identical to NEXTAUTH_URL.
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL="http://localhost:3000"

# ── Analytics (free, cookieless — only loads in prod when flag is "true") ─────
# Set NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=true in Vercel env (prod only).
# Cloudflare Web Analytics → https://dash.cloudflare.com → Web Analytics
# Microsoft Clarity → https://clarity.microsoft.com
NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ENABLED="false"
NEXT_PUBLIC_CF_BEACON_TOKEN=""      # 32-char hex from Cloudflare Web Analytics
NEXT_PUBLIC_CLARITY_PROJECT_ID=""   # ~10-char ID from Microsoft Clarity

# ── Error monitoring / observability (Sentry) ──────────────────────────────
# Server-side Sentry DSN (ingest errors from app/api and server-side renders).
# Read by apps/web/lib/observability/sentry.ts. If unset, error reporting
# no-ops — the app still runs but NO server-side crash visibility exists in
# production, so operators fly blind on backend errors.
# Leave the trailing path intact; paste the full DSN value from your Sentry
# project settings.
SENTRY_DSN=""
# Client-side Sentry DSN (browser errors, network failures). Must be a
# NEXT_PUBLIC_* var so the client bundle can read it. If unset, client-side
# error collection is silently disabled.
NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=""

# ── Health-alert cron delivery (observability) ─────────────────────────────
# The /api/cron/health-alert cron (every 15 min, see vercel.json) evaluates
# live capability probes and decides whether to page. If this URL is set, it
# POSTs a short JSON payload there (Slack / Discord / generic webhook). If
# UNSET, health degradation is detectable via /api/health (returns 503) but
# NO push alert is delivered to anyone — set this or wire an external uptime
# monitor (see docs/ops/INCIDENT_RUNBOOK.md §2, line 110).
HEALTH_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL=""

# ============================================================
# Bootstrap Progression Flags
#
# These flags control the trust readiness of the platform.
# All default to "false" (safest mode) — enable in sequence
# only when the system meets the described prerequisites.
#
# Bootstrap Progression Guide:
#
# STEP 1 — Accumulate canonical history (prerequisite for everything else)
#   Set CANONICAL_HISTORY_ENABLED=true ONLY when:
#     - The Odds API key is validated and returning real data
#     - DB schema migrations have been run (prisma db push)
#     - At least 1 successful ingestion run has been verified
#   Effect: New picks and TeamGameLogs are written with isBootstrap=false.
#           Bootstrap-era records stay bootstrap forever.
#
# STEP 2 — Enable derived model history (ATS/H2H scoring)
#   Set DERIVED_MODEL_HISTORY_ENABLED=true ONLY when:
#     - CANONICAL_HISTORY_ENABLED has been true for ≥7 days
#     - At least 20 canonical TeamGameLog entries exist per sport
#     - ATS form data has been spot-checked for accuracy
#   Effect: ATS form, H2H form, and venue splits feed the scoring engine.
#           Only non-bootstrap logs are used (canonicalOnly=true filter).
#
# STEP 3 — Expose public picks endpoint
#   Set PUBLIC_PICKS_ENABLED=true ONLY when:
#     - DERIVED_MODEL_HISTORY_ENABLED=true (model is using real signals)
#     - At least 1 week of canonical picks exist
#     - Pick confidence has been manually verified as reasonable
#   Effect: /api/picks and /api/picks/daily-slate return data.
#           Bootstrap picks are always excluded from public responses.
#
# STEP 4 — Enable featured pick promotion
#   Set FEATURED_PICK_PROMOTION_ENABLED=true ONLY when:
#     - PUBLIC_PICKS_ENABLED=true
#     - Pick grades have been observed across multiple cycles
#     - ELITE_PLAY / STRONG_PLAY grades appear at expected frequency
#   Effect: High-confidence picks (ELITE_PLAY, STRONG_PLAY ≥80) get isFeatured=true.
#
# STEP 5 — Expose performance stats
#   Set PERFORMANCE_STATS_ENABLED=true ONLY when:
#     - At least 30 canonical picks have been settled (WIN/LOSS/PUSH)
#     - Win rates have been spot-checked against actual game outcomes
#   Effect: /api/performance returns data. Only isBootstrap=false picks counted.
#
# STEP 6 — Publish blog content
#   Set PUBLIC_BLOG_ENABLED=true ONLY when:
#     - PUBLIC_PICKS_ENABLED=true (content must reference real picks)
#     - ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is configured
#   Effect: content-publishing worker generates and publishes blog posts.
#           Only canonical (non-bootstrap) picks are cited in content.
# ============================================================

CANONICAL_HISTORY_ENABLED="false"
DERIVED_MODEL_HISTORY_ENABLED="false"
PUBLIC_PICKS_ENABLED="false"
FEATURED_PICK_PROMOTION_ENABLED="false"
PERFORMANCE_STATS_ENABLED="false"
PUBLIC_BLOG_ENABLED="false"

# How to display confidence to users: "labels" (Free/Pro/Elite) or "numeric" (0-100)
# Use "labels" until model confidence is calibrated against real historical results.
CONFIDENCE_DISPLAY_MODE="labels"

# Minimum data quality score (0-100) required to write a TeamGameLog entry.
# Games with thin bookmaker coverage have unreliable spread data for ATS tracking.
# Default: 40. Increase to 60+ once the system has sufficient data density.
MIN_DATA_QUALITY_FOR_GAME_LOG="40"

# STEP 7 — Enable outcome-anchored learning data collection
#   Set OUTCOME_LEARNING_ENABLED=true ONLY when:
#     - PERFORMANCE_STATS_ENABLED=true (enough canonical data exists)
#     - At least 100 canonical picks have settled with verified outcomes
#     - You have confirmed settlement accuracy (outcomes match real game results)
#   Effect: Settled canonical PickSignalSnapshots become eligibleForLearning=true.
#           This gates DATA COLLECTION only — it does NOT automatically change
#           confidence weights or scoring. Calibration adjustments require an
#           explicit model version bump and human review.
#   The model ONLY learns from: real settlement results + signal state at prediction
#   time. It NEVER learns from: its own prior confidence, prior reasoning text, or
#   prior pick grades in isolation from real outcomes.
OUTCOME_LEARNING_ENABLED="false"

# Minimum settled canonical picks required before learning data is meaningful.
# Below this threshold, sample size is too small to distinguish signal from noise.
# Increase to 500+ for statistically robust calibration per signal category.
MIN_SETTLED_PICKS_FOR_LEARNING="100"

#   Set CALIBRATION_ADJUSTMENTS_ENABLED=true ONLY after completing ALL steps in
#   docs/path-to-70.md §7:
#     1. ≥100 learning-eligible settled picks (OUTCOME_LEARNING_ENABLED must have
#        been on when they settled — not retroactively counted)
#     2. Held-out / offline validation confirms calibratedEce ≤ rawEce out-of-sample
#     3. MODEL_VERSION bumped in constants.ts + CalibrationProposal audit-trail entry
#        per docs/calibration-proposals/FROZEN.md
#   Only then flip this to true. The isotonic calibrator is self-suppressing (identity
#   passthrough) when inactive — premature activation has no effect but blurs the audit.
CALIBRATION_ADJUSTMENTS_ENABLED="false"

# Stale-Data Kill Switch for the PUBLIC picks surface (ships DARK — default off).
#   When "true": /api/picks and the public board loaders auto-suppress (render the
#   same "collecting"/empty state they already use) whenever the latest successful
#   ingestion run is "stale" per the shared Refresh SLA (240m, see
#   apps/web/lib/data-reliability/refresh-sla.ts). This enforces the "no stale data"
#   rule at the read boundary so PUBLIC_PICKS_ENABLED can be lifted safely.
#   When "false" (default): NO freshness check runs — behavior is identical to today.
FORCE_NO_BET_IF_STALE="false"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CFB / NFL DATA-SOURCE CANDIDATES — EVALUATION ONLY, NOT YET WIRED
#
# These are owner-review candidates (see apps/web/lib/scraping/sports-data-candidates.ts).
# Do NOT use any of them in production, public claims, StatKing evidence, Airwave
# feeds, or automation until they clear the source-provider + clearance gates and
# are promoted into source-rights-registry.ts with verified terms.
#
# Keys belong here as VALUES at runtime — never commit a real key. If a key was ever
# shared in plaintext (chat, screenshot, ticket), ROTATE it before use.
# THE_ODDS_API_KEY is the licensed, already-wired provider (see above) — its NCAAF
# coverage rides the existing key.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CFBD_API_KEY=""              # CollegeFootballData — free tier 1,000 calls/mo
# BALLDONTLIE_API_KEY=""       # balldontlie NCAAF — free tier ~5 req/min
# HIGHLIGHTLY_API_KEY=""       # Highlightly NFL/NCAA — free 100 req/day
# API_SPORTS_KEY=""            # API-SPORTS NFL & NCAA — free 100 req/day
# BIGBALLS_API_KEY=""          # Big Balls Sports Data — free 1,000–2,000 req/day
# THERUNDOWN_API_KEY=""        # TheRundown — free 20,000 data points/day (5-min delay)
# SHARPAPI_KEY=""              # SharpAPI NCAAF Odds — free 12 req/min
# SPORTSGAMEODDS_API_KEY=""    # SportsGameOdds — free trial
# SPORTSGAMEDATA_API_KEY=""    # Sports Game Data — free 2,500 objects/mo
# SPORTSDATAIO_API_KEY=""      # SportsDataIO College Football — free trial (commercial feed)
# SPORTRADAR_API_KEY=""        # Sportradar NCAA Football v7 — marketplace trial
# ROLLING_INSIGHTS_API_KEY=""  # Rolling Insights / DataFeeds — 30-day trial
# RAPIDAPI_KEY=""              # RapidAPI NCAA/CFB freemium listings — experimental
# STORYSTATS_API_KEY=""        # StoryStats API — free tier 10 req/day (ROTATE shared key)
# THESPORTSDB_API_KEY=""       # TheSportsDB — free/dev key tier (metadata, artwork; verify limits live)
# FOOTBALL_DATA_ORG_KEY=""     # football-data.org — free tier, restricted competitions (soccer expansion)
#
# henrygd NCAA API (FREE, no key). Defaults to the public demo (5 req/sec/IP).
# Self-host via docker/docker-compose.yml (service: ncaa-api) and point here to
# drop the rate cap: http://localhost:3000 (or http://ncaa-api:3000 in-compose).
# HENRYGD_NCAA_BASE_URL=""
#
# Internal-LLM tier (OpenAI-compatible) — route NON-user-facing LLM work (classification,
# normalization, drafts) off Claude to cut cost. Off unless BASE_URL + MODEL are set.
# Groq (free tier):  https://api.groq.com/openai/v1  +  llama-3.3-70b-versatile  + GROQ key
# Ollama (self-host): http://localhost:11434/v1  +  e.g. llama3.1  (no key)
INTERNAL_LLM_BASE_URL="https://api.groq.com/openai/v1"
INTERNAL_LLM_MODEL="llama-3.3-70b-versatile"
INTERNAL_LLM_API_KEY=""   # Groq key from console.groq.com (free tier); omit for Ollama

# ── Free content lane (Cerebras) — non-user-facing only ──
# free-lane.ts: both must be set. ~1M tok/day free tier typical.
CEREBRAS_API_KEY=""
CONTENT_FREE_LANE_ENABLED="false"
# Secondary free OpenAI-compat host (Gemma/Nemotron free APIs) after Cerebras fails
FREE_LANE_SECONDARY_BASE_URL=""
FREE_LANE_SECONDARY_API_KEY=""
FREE_LANE_SECONDARY_MODEL=""
FREE_LANE_SECONDARY_LEDGER_PREFIX="free-secondary/"

# The internal-LLM seam is OpenAI-compatible, so Google Gemini can drop straight in
# (pay non-user-facing drafting with Google for Startups credits, no new code):
#   INTERNAL_LLM_BASE_URL="https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai"
#   INTERNAL_LLM_MODEL="gemini-2.0-flash"   INTERNAL_LLM_API_KEY="<AI Studio key>"

# ── Claude provider routing — the AWS-credits play (see
#    docs/ops/CLOUD_CREDITS_MAXIMIZATION_STRATEGY_2026-07-08.md) ──
# Claude on AWS Bedrock is the same model at identical pricing, but the spend is
# billable to AWS Activate GenAI credits instead of the Anthropic bill. Inert by
# default: with CLAUDE_PROVIDER unset (or no AWS creds) every call uses the direct
# Anthropic API, byte-identical to today. Set to "bedrock" only after the staging
# smoke test confirms responses carry a Bedrock model id.
CLAUDE_PROVIDER=""                 # "" | "auto" | "bedrock" | "vertex" | "azure" — see Jynx
JYNX_MODE=""                       # "auto" same as CLAUDE_PROVIDER=auto (multi-cloud credits)
JYNX_CLOUD_ORDER="bedrock,azure,vertex"  # preference when auto / failover
JYNX_CLOUD_FAILOVER="true"         # try next cloud before Anthropic cash
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=""
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=""
AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=""               # only for temporary STS credentials; omit otherwise
AWS_BEDROCK_REGION=""              # e.g. us-east-1 (falls back to AWS_REGION)
# NO fabricated ids: Bedrock model ids are account/region-specific and must be
# confirmed in the Bedrock console after model access is granted. Map Anthropic
# ids → verified Bedrock ids (unmapped models fall back to Anthropic, never guess):
BEDROCK_MODEL_MAP=""               # e.g. {"claude-sonnet-4-6":"<verified-bedrock-id>"}

# ── Google Vertex AI provider — the $10k Anthropic partner-credit path ──

body:
# GitGuardian secret-scanning configuration.
#
# Excludes test fixtures from scanning, not production code. Test files
# routinely contain deliberately fake-looking credentials (e.g. "sk_test_..."
# stripe fixtures, mock API keys) that are not real secrets but read as
# high-confidence matches to a generic scanner. This repo already has its own
# secret-scan guardrail (scripts/guardrails/secret-scan.mjs, run pre-commit)
# covering the real repository; this exclusion narrows GitGuardian to reduce
# noise, not to widen what either scanner actually protects.
paths-ignore:
  - "**/__tests__/**"
  - "**/*.test.ts"
  - "**/*.test.mjs"
  - "**/fixtures/**"

# Socket Security — supply-chain hardening via GitHub App.
#
# This file configures the installed Socket GitHub App (free tier, no secret needed).
# Socket detects typosquatting, malicious dependencies, and exfiltration behavior —
# capabilities complementary to the ci.yml dependency-audit guardrail (which only
# runs `npm audit` for CVE detection).
#
# Scope: this config is inert until the Socket GitHub App is installed on the repo.
# It requires NO repository secret. Verified 2026-08-17 via P15-01 inventory.
#
# Pull-request-only behavior is the Socket App's default (it posts on PRs); this
# config tunes it DOWN to summary-level output per sprint doctrine: ~290 commits
# on the eventual PR would produce an unreadable flood with line-by-line defaults.
version: 2

# Only scan PRs, never push events or schedules that could fight existing crons.
githubApp:
  enabled: true
  # Summary-level review, not line-by-line nitpicks.
  dependencyOverviewEnabled: true
  # Suppress per-file comments on huge diffs; surface a single summary instead.
  pullRequestAlertsEnabled: false
  disableCommentsAndCheckRuns: false

# Ignore generated/vendor dirs so the app doesn't waste its free budget.
projectIgnorePaths:
  - "**/*.min.js"
  - "**/dist/**"
  - "**/node_modules/**"
  - "**/.next/**"
  - "**/build/**"
